FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 473
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Arnold Mooney
Security
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/23/2026
House Bill 473 as introduced would expand security provided by the Alabama Law
Enforcement Agency to include the new Alabama State House, park and the new parking deck,
and certain official legislative events, as provided by this bill.
